narrative: The almanac open at the day in a dim nave. The leaf names two saints and does not grow a sermon. Master Thwaite is at the desk, not speaking to the lodging. No face.

entities.name: William Shakespeare
entities.context: Stood the prayer and did not lengthen it.

entities.name: Master Josias Thwaite
entities.context: Read the evening prayer and was not asked for more.

entities.name: the almanac
entities.context: Shown on almanac in Simon and Jude
